ITERATED MAPS / CHAOS

Clifford attractor

A point follows a pair of equations. Its visits become a luminous density field.

x′ = sin(ay) + c cos(ax); y′ = sin(bx) + d cos(by)

A FEW WAYS IN

ARROWS ADJUST a / b · SPACE FOR PRESETS · P PAUSES ACCUMULATION

The mathematics

Both new coordinates use the previous point simultaneously. The renderer counts visits to each grid cell, then colors logarithmic density. The default constants are c = 1 and d = 0.7; Space selects another preset. Changing a or b restarts accumulation. Some parameters settle to simple cycles instead of a strange attractor.
